title: Izeezus drops a new track "Falling For"
htmlContent:
Izeezus's "Falling For" is the perfect tune to add some light to your life today and beyond. It’s that feel good music that brings people together and makes the world move, with a track that takes you on a journey that you hope never stops.

The production sets the tone, with Izeezus using his deep lyrics and vulnerable vocal approach, to make a genius level connection to make it modern day soul music for the masses.
